overview: Coordinate filter changes with a generation key but give each widget an independent query/error boundary. Limit parallel requests, pause refresh in hidden tabs and request server aggregation/downsampling for the visible chart resolution. The graph separates browser interaction state, server query state and the existing backend. It is one defensible approach; equivalent boundaries and well-argued alternatives are welcome.
limitations: Design checks inspect structure and written evidence only; they do not execute a UI or prove accessibility/performance.

estimation.calculation: 12,000 displayed points; at least 3 request waves if all start cold
estimation.result: Prioritize visible widgets and downsample before transfer
estimation.implication: Measure chart render time, network waterfalls and filter-to-first-widget latency.

components.purpose: Keyboard, pointer, touch and assistive-technology entry point. Client architecture only; backend internals are external dependencies.
components.rationale: Own this responsibility at the Browser / User boundary; keep communication explicit through the diagrammed dependency.

components.purpose: Coordinate filter changes with a generation key but give each widget an independent query/error boundary. Limit parallel requests, pause refresh in hidden tabs and request server aggregation/downsampling for the visible chart resolution. Performance plan: 12 widgets, each at most 1,000 displayed points; 4 concurrent queries; hidden-tab refresh suspended. Accessibility: Each chart has a title, units, textual summary and accessible table/download alternative; keyboard controls for filters and layout, distinguish data series beyond color. Failure recovery: Reject obsolete keys, show per-widget error and retain clearly marked stale data only when its range is visible. Never label old-range data as current. Trade-off: A batched endpoint reduces requests but can couple slow widgets. Independent queries improve isolation; server snapshot tokens are needed if exact cross-widget consistency matters.
components.rationale: Own this responsibility at the Analytics Dashboard View boundary; keep communication explicit through the diagrammed dependency.
